title: Flange connections in built-up beams

requirements.weld_line_count: n=2 for two-sided welds; n=1 for one-sided welds

definitions.T: Q*S/I, flange shear flow per unit length using gross flange static moment and gross section moment of inertia

definitions.k: Number of friction planes under clauses 14.3.3-14.3.4

alpha.0.4: Load on the upper flange when the web edge is planed to that flange
alpha.1.0: No web-edge planing or load on the lower flange

notes: A weld penetrating the full web thickness is treated as equal-strength with the web.
